method.source: Committed Git blobs only; excludes all uncommitted files.
method.scope: All tracked files except archived/; archived contents not read.
method.kind_hint: Filename-based triage only, not semantic file classification.
method.go_non_test: Includes tools and support code; does not mean shipped production code.
method.generated_header: Standard Go header detection only, not all generated artifacts.
method.declarations: Lexical top-level Go test/example/fuzz/benchmark declarations, not executed cases or subtests.
method.package_count: Directories with non-test Go files; no build-tag or dependency resolution.
method.review_status: Inventory alone is not a semantic review; pilot coverage is separate.
